court: In the High Court of Madras
respondents: Superintendent of Police and Another .…. Respondents.
advocates: For Respondents: Mr. M. Mohamed Riyaz Additional Public Prosecutor
prayer: PRAYER: Criminal Original Petition filed under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C., to direct the 2nd respondent not to harass the petitioner and her family members based on the complaint dated 19.07.2019.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

N. Anand Venkatesh, J.:— This Criminal Original Petition has been filed for a direction to direct the 2nd respondent not to harass the petitioner and her family members based on the complaint dated 19.07.2019.

2. Heard the learned Counsel appearing for the petitioner and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing on behalf of the respondent police.

3. Taking into consideration the nature of the dispute involved in this case is a money dispute, it is for the parties to adjudicate the same before the appropriate Civil Court and the respondent police will have no role to play in a case of this nature.

4. This Criminal Original Petition is disposed of with a direction to the respondent police not to interfere with the money dispute and it is open for the parties to agitate their rights before the competent civil court.
